game_concept: A adventure race set in Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest, a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain: the ash ranger must handle ember hounds while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Comparison Duel: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the ash ranger's power beats the shield shown by ember hounds.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Charred Forest: a burnt forest at the foot of the mountain
core_gameplay_loop: In Charred Forest, repeat each round: Choose ==, !=, < , > or >= so the ash ranger's power beats the shield shown by ember hounds. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the ash ranger ahead. Then check the power value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the smelter by solving code steps involving power that move the ash ranger forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the smelter first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 4 (applied tier): Comparison Duel
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comparison Duel' (Week 2 slot 5), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Charred Forest'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against ember hounds in Charred Forest.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.8).
